profile.name: David Timothy Yoro
profile.location: Davao City · Remote (Serving US & Canadian Clients)
profile.bio: I architect enterprise-grade AI outbound calling engines, multi-agent enrichment systems, and seamless CRM integrations using Telnyx AI, n8n, Make, GoHighLevel, and Twilio — saving 20+ hours weekly and converting cold leads into warm transfers.

projects.title: Autonomous Lead-to-Revenue Engine (ALRE)
projects.desc: Multi-agent qualification pipeline combining Firecrawl scraping, Apollo API enrichment, multi-stage LLM scoring, and automatic CRM synchronization.
projects.problem: Sales teams spent 15+ hours weekly researching raw leads, leading to slow speed-to-lead and lost opportunities.
projects.solution: Built a multi-agent workflow using n8n, Firecrawl for website scraping, Apollo API for enrichment, and ChatGPT Models for lead tiering.
projects.result: Automated 500+ monthly prospects with a 95% reduction in manual research time.

projects.title: End-to-End AI Voice Agent & CRM System
projects.desc: High-fidelity conversational AI agent with 34+ objection handlers, real-time qualification triggers, voicemail SMS loops, and instant warm sales transfers.
projects.problem: Manual cold outbound calls suffered from high rep fatigue, slow follow-ups, and inconsistent qualification criteria.
projects.solution: Deployed Telnyx AI with 34+ objection handlers, Make.com webhook routing, and automatic CRM field synchronizers.
projects.result: Achieved 85% automated call handling with instant live warm transfers to human closers.

projects.title: GHL + ClubWorx Unified Member Experience
projects.desc: Hybrid enterprise integration bridging lead funnels with member management, automating onboarding credential delivery and removing 90% admin overhead.
projects.problem: Disjointed lead acquisition in GHL versus student roster in Clubworx caused duplicated data and manual admin chaos.
projects.solution: Engineered a two-way API sync and automated student onboarding credential dispatcher.
projects.result: Eliminated duplicate data entries and saved 90% of recurring operational time.

projects.title: AI Customer Service Agent
projects.desc: Context-aware conversational agent with vector search & persistent memory for 24/7 client inquiries.
projects.problem: High volume of recurring inquiries left customers waiting hours during off-peak windows.
projects.solution: Created an n8n webhook workflow with Google ChatGPT Models (OpenAI) and persistent session memory.
projects.result: Reached 90% automated query resolution in under 3 seconds with zero human delay.

projects.title: Auto YouTube Shorts Creator
projects.desc: Automated prompt synthesis, video generation, captioning, and multi-platform publishing.
projects.problem: Creating high-frequency video content required tedious editing and manual publishing across platforms.
projects.solution: Built an n8n pipeline that synthesizes script prompts, generates AI video assets, and posts automatically.
projects.result: Scaled output from 2 to 15 quality short-form videos weekly.

projects.title: Marketing Sales Funnel Automation
projects.desc: Instant lead categorization, weighted agent distribution, and condition-based email cadences.
projects.problem: Unsorted leads slipped through cracks without structured email cadences.
projects.solution: Built condition-based branching in n8n for lead priority scoring and auto-assignment.

projects.title: HubSpot & Monday.com Sync Engine
projects.desc: Real-time webhook listener bridging lead creation in HubSpot directly to PM board in Monday.com.
projects.problem: HubSpot submissions were not mirrored onto Monday.com boards in real-time.
projects.solution: Architected Make scenario to catch form webhooks and populate boards with instant notifications.
projects.result: Achieved 100% real-time data sync with zero manual copy-paste.

projects.title: AI Attachment Data Capture Pipeline
projects.desc: Gmail attachment extractor analyzing PDF/receipt data with ChatGPT Models (OpenAI) into structured spreadsheet rows.
projects.problem: Extracting tabular financial data from email PDF attachments was time-consuming and error-prone.
projects.solution: Engineered a Gmail trigger running ChatGPT Models Vision to parse document values into Google Sheets.
projects.result: Saved 15+ hours weekly with 98% data accuracy.

projects.title: The 'Closed-Loop' Lead Conversion Engine
projects.desc: Webhooks + Apollo API enrichment delivering instant multi-channel outreach in under 25 seconds.
projects.problem: Slow response times on form opt-ins resulted in high prospect drop-off.
projects.solution: Developed a Zapier webhook pipeline enriched via Apollo that triggers SMS & email in 25 seconds.
projects.result: Cut response time to under 25s and boosted conversions by 25%.

projects.title: Autonomous Content Repurposing
projects.desc: Audio/video transcript parser that generates multi-format social threads and newsletters.
projects.problem: Repurposing raw audio into articles and social copy required hours of manual drafting.
projects.solution: Built a Zapier pipeline running Whisper and LLMs to distribute to Facebook and Instagram.
projects.result: Cut content turn-around from 4 hours to 15 minutes.

projects.title: HighLevel Lead Magnet & Nurture
projects.desc: Conditional opt-in delivery with dynamic 48-hour follow-up triggers preventing lead drop-off.
projects.problem: Leads downloaded digital assets and ghosted before booking consultations.
projects.solution: Designed GHL workflow with conditional delay triggers for personalized check-ins.
projects.result: Maximized lead engagement and recovered cold downloads without manual effort.

projects.title: Dormant Lead Reactivation System
projects.desc: Automated identification of 60+ day inactive contacts with tailored multi-touch value drops.
projects.problem: Inactive CRM contacts remained unmonetized after initial campaign drop-off.
projects.solution: Created automated GHL trigger identifying 60-day cold contacts with high-value reactivation campaigns.
projects.result: Reactivated 25% of dormant contacts into booked sales calls.

projects.title: Smart Appointment Reminder System
projects.desc: Automated SMS, email, and voice reminders dispatched strategically at 48h, 24h, and 2h pre-call.
projects.problem: High no-show rates wasted sales reps' scheduled calendar slots.
projects.solution: Implemented automated multi-touch SMS, email, and voice confirmations at 48h, 24h, and 2h.

projects.title: End-to-End Sales Pipeline Engine
projects.desc: Opportunity stage automation triggering auto-tasks, rep assignments, and buyer persona tagging.
projects.problem: Disorganized deal stages caused bottlenecks in sales follow-up.
projects.solution: Engineered automated stage progression, rep task assignments, and conditional notifications.
